light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a ranch hand with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the kitchen behind stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, daylight from the window and the open door, no lamps. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores and uneven tone; hair with stray curls; the denim shirt faded and creased, the leather apron scuffed. Food looks like real home cooking, not styled. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld video filmed by a ranch hand with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the kitchen in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and rough working hands; he moves naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

anchors.prompt: Claudio, a weathered 58-year-old Mexican-American ranch cook with curly black hair streaked with gray under a worn natural straw cowboy hat, a short gray-black beard and mustache, brown eyes, sun-tanned lined skin, wearing a faded blue denim work shirt with pearl snap buttons and the sleeves rolled to the forearms, a red bandana knotted at the neck and a worn brown leather apron stands by the deep window holding a chipped enamel cup of black coffee, the dusty corral and two horses outside behind him. The place: the old cook house kitchen of a working cattle ranch: whitewashed adobe walls, heavy dark wooden ceiling beams, worn terracotta tile floor; a deep window with a peeling green-painted wooden frame in the thick adobe wall, outside a dusty corral with a weathered wooden fence and two brown horses, dry grass and low hills in late afternoon sun. Seen from a ranch hand's handheld camera at eye level, a medium shot from the waist up. He wears the same worn straw cowboy hat, faded blue denim snap shirt with rolled sleeves, red bandana and brown leather apron the whole time, same curly black-and-gray hair and short gray-black beard, same face as the reference.

Same place, same people, same light as the first image, a few seconds later. the cup lowered, a relaxed smile at the camera, the horses outside. He wears the same worn straw cowboy hat, faded blue denim snap shirt with rolled sleeves, red bandana and brown leather apron the whole time, same curly black-and-gray hair and short gray-black beard, same face as the reference.

clips.text: That's the hard part. Waiting. This is a Sunday-afternoon pot. Or a pot you start at three and eat at six. It doesn't need you. It just needs you to look in on it now and then.
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, takes a sip of coffee and looks out the window, then back at the camera. daylight from the window and the open door, no lamps. He wears the same worn straw cowboy hat, faded blue denim snap shirt with rolled sleeves, red bandana and brown leather apron the whole time, same curly black-and-gray hair and short gray-black beard, same face as the reference.
